Inner Outer: The BCJR algorithm can also decode convolutional inner codes over the IDS channel by considering all combinations of convolutional and drift states [13].
Drift Sliding Window: We demonstrate that this decoder, named ConvBCJRFormer, achieves error rates only slightly worse than BCJR decoding while offering a generalizable mechanism to incorporate linear code information.
